title: Sheinbaum Directs Recovered García Luna Funds to Guerrero Schools, Renews Criticism of Calderón's Drug War
detail: At her August 28, 2026 morning press conference, President Claudia Sheinbaum announced that $5,805,693.50 recovered from a civil judgment against the Weinberg family — collateral and the liquidation of 12 Florida properties tied to a money-laundering scheme built around Calderón's security chief Genaro García Luna — would fund secondary and higher education in the Montaña region of Guerrero, calling it the first time funds from this kind of litigation have been returned to Mexico's public treasury. The Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF) reported the underlying scheme moved roughly $403.9 million in fraudulent government contracts between 2008 and 2018, and cited 61 arrest warrants and 17 detentions to date. Sheinbaum used the announcement to renew criticism of Calderón's 2006 drug war, arguing it amounted to an undeclared 'state of exception' in which security forces operated outside normal legal bounds, and asked the opposition to address García Luna's proven corruption rather than accuse her administration of running a 'narco-state.'
